parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $x:1,2,3,4,5$ and $P(X=x):5/15,4/15,3/15,2/15,1/15$ (equivalently $40/120,32/120,24/120,16/120,8/120$; decimals $0.3333,0.2667,0.2000,0.1333,0.06667$). B1 table with correct $x$ values and at least one correct probability. B1 a second correct probability correctly linked to its $x$ value; need not be in table; accept unsimplified. B1 two more correct probabilities correctly linked; need not be in table; accept unsimplified. B1 all five correct probabilities linked with correct $x$ values. SCB1 for five non-zero probabilities, not all $1/5$, summing to 1 in a probability-distribution table with correct $x$ values if B1B1 maximum scored. SCB2 for the same probabilities linked to $x=0,1,2,3,4$, OE. Total: 4.

steps.guidance: Correct x-values and at least one correct linked probability.
A second correct linked probability; unsimplified forms are accepted.
All five probabilities correctly linked. Apply the printed SCB1 rule for a non-uniform table summing to 1 if at most B2, or SCB2 if these probabilities are instead linked to $x=0,1,2,3,4$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $E(X)=1(5/15)+2(4/15)+3(3/15)+4(2/15)+5(1/15)=35/15=7/3$. M1; accept unsimplified; may be calculated in variance; FT their table with five or six probabilities summing to 1, $0<p<1$. $\operatorname{Var}(X)=1^2(5/15)+2^2(4/15)+3^2(3/15)+4^2(2/15)+5^2(1/15)-(35/15)^2=14/9=1.56$. M1 appropriate variance formula using their $[E(X)]^2$; FT their table with four or more probabilities, $0<p<1$, which need not sum to 1, or an expression no more evaluated than shown. A1 AWRT; WWW but allow truncation error. Note $14/9$ also comes from SCB2 but scores M1M1A0 maximum. Total: 3.

steps.guidance: Accept unsimplified; may be calculated within the variance. FT their table with five or six probabilities summing to $1$, each $0<p<1$.
Use the appropriate variance formula with their $[E(X)]^2$. FT their table with four or more probabilities, each $0<p<1$, which need not sum to $1$, or an expression no more evaluated than shown.
AWRT and WWW; allow truncation error. Note $14/9$ can arise from SCB2 but then scores M1M1A0 maximum.
